privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: Welcome to "Boss Timer" (hereinafter referred to as this website). To ensure you can use the services and information of this website with peace of mind, we hereby explain our privacy policy to protect your rights. Please read the following content carefully:
privacy.section1Content: The privacy policy covers how this website handles personally identifiable information collected when you use the website services. The privacy policy does not apply to related linked websites outside of this website, nor to personnel not commissioned or involved in the management of this website.
privacy.section2Title: II. Collection, Processing, and Use of Personal Data
privacy.section2Content1: When you log in via Google or participate in activities on this website, we will ask you to provide necessary personal data, and we will process and use your personal data within that specific purpose. The personal data collected by this website includes:
privacy.section2ListItem1: Public data from Google: Your name, email address, and avatar URL.
privacy.section2ListItem2: Data you generate: Room information, Boss timing records, etc., that you create within the application.
privacy.section2Content2: This data is used by this website internally and for the purpose of collection (e.g., for identity verification, personalizing your experience, displaying your username and avatar), or as necessary to provide services or fulfill contractual obligations. Unless we obtain your consent or as required by relevant laws, this website will not provide your personal data to third parties or use it for purposes other than collection.
privacy.section3Content: The host servers of this website are equipped with firewalls, anti-virus systems, and other related information security equipment and necessary security measures to protect the website and your personal data. We adopt strict protection measures, and only authorized personnel can access your personal data.
privacy.section4Title: IV. External Links on the Website
privacy.section4Content: The web pages of this website provide network links to other websites. When you click on links provided by this website to enter other websites, the privacy policy of this website does not apply. You must refer to the privacy policy of the linked website.
privacy.section5Title: V. Policy on Sharing Personal Data with Third Parties
privacy.section5Content: This website will never provide, exchange, rent, or sell any of your personal data to other individuals, groups, private enterprises, or public agencies, except where there is a legal basis or contractual obligation.
privacy.section6Content: To provide you with the best service, this website will place and access our cookies on your computer. If you do not wish to accept the writing of cookies, you can set the privacy level in your browser functions to high to refuse the writing of cookies, but this may cause some functions of the website to not perform normally.
privacy.section7Content: This website uses Microsoft Clarity to analyze how users interact with the site. Clarity uses cookies and other technologies to collect data on user interaction behavior, including but not limited to page views, clicks, mouse movements, and scrolling behavior. This data is used to generate heatmaps and session recordings to help us understand user experience and improve the website. All collected data is anonymized and will not be used to identify individual users. For more information, please refer to the
privacy.section8Title: VIII. Amendment of the Privacy Policy
privacy.section8Content: The privacy policy of this website will be amended at any time in response to needs, and the revised terms will be updated on the website.

v2_7_0.title: v2.7.0
items: New: Feedback / Wishlist tab (Settings > Feedback). Submit bugs or feature ideas; sign in to upvote others' suggestions. Most-wanted items rise to the top automatically.
New: Added a GitHub Star link to the Support page — a free way to help the project reach more players.

v2_6_6.title: v2.6.6
items: Redesign: Recommended Channels is now a tactical-ledger style list showing may-respawn channels across all bosses, with a radial countdown ring and urgency color coding
Enhancement: Channel status update precision improved from 10 seconds to 1 second — Respawning → May Respawn transitions are now near-instant
Fix: Channel status sometimes getting stuck at Respawning after the countdown ended
Fix: Expired indicator (faded overlay on Alive channels) not updating reactively over time

v2_6_5.title: v2.6.5
items: New: Recommended Channels now shows may-respawn channels across all bosses, not just the currently selected one
Enhancement: Adjusted channel column width in Channel Overview for cleaner display

v2_6_4.title: v2.6.4
items: Fix: Recommended Channels no longer shows 'Alive' bosses (past max respawn time) — now correctly shows only 'May Respawn' channels
Enhancement: Channel Overview now shows only records from the past 2 days (down from 3), keeping the view cleaner for long-running rooms
Enhancement: Multiple internal architectural refactors improving overall stability and performance

v2_6_3.title: v2.6.3
items: Fix: WebSocket connection leak — improved server stability over long sessions
Fix: Automatically redirected to home on disconnect, preventing being stuck on an unusable empty room page
Fix: Router infinite loop when the backend was unreachable, causing the page to freeze
Enhancement: Server-side heartbeat detection now identifies dead connections more promptly

v2_6_2.title: v2.6.2
items: New: Record History is now a full audit log with date-range (up to 30 days) and Boss filters, plus infinite scroll
Enhancement: Channel Overview now dedupes at the database level (DISTINCT ON) and only shows records from the past 3 days — long-running rooms stay clean
Enhancement: Joining a room or recording a kill now updates the room's last-active timestamp, preventing active rooms from being mistakenly cleaned up early
Fix: Records are no longer auto-archived daily — they persist until the room is inactive for 7 days or the user manually deletes them

v2_6_1.title: v2.6.1
items: Enhancement: Numeric keyboard now appears automatically when entering a channel number on mobile
Enhancement: Status buttons now display icon + label directly with color coding (green / red / gray) — no more hover-only tooltips
Enhancement: When the control panel is at ¼ width, status buttons automatically switch to icon-only compact mode
Fix: Clicking outside the status buttons no longer accidentally triggers a submission
Fix: Custom Bosses from a previous room no longer carry over when switching rooms

Enhancement: When entering a new room, the previously selected Boss is automatically restored; if it was a custom Boss, the first custom Boss in the new room is tried next, then favorites, then the default

v2_6_0.title: v2.6.0
items: New: Custom Boss per room — define room-specific bosses with a custom name and respawn range (Room Settings > Custom Bosses)
New: Draggable layout — reorder widgets and resize them across 4 width steps (¼ to full width)
New: Widget collapse — collapse any widget to a slim title bar; click to expand
New: User Guide page (footer > User Guide) explaining how to use the main features
Enhancement: Layout upgraded to a 4-column grid for more flexible widget placement
Enhancement: Deleting a custom Boss now clears related records and Discord alert schedules, with a confirmation prompt

v2_5_0.title: v2.5.0
items: New: Channel overview now includes a 'Respawn Timeline' view — a Gantt-style chart showing boss status history per channel, with filters for killed / alive / not found
New: Boss selector supports 'Favorites' — pin frequently tracked bosses to the top of the dropdown (synced across devices when logged in)
New: Channel cards now show an 'expired' indicator when an alive status has exceeded its maximum respawn window
Enhancement: Channel view preference (card / timeline) is now saved and synced across devices

v2_4_1.title: v2.4.1 (Backend v2.6.1)
items: New: 'Recent Rooms' panel to quickly rejoin previous rooms
New: Custom sound settings and browser notification alerts
New: Support for Discord Room-Specific Webhooks (including kill, alive, missing states, and respawn window intervals)
New: Click on a history record's text to quickly switch the currently selected BOSS
Enhancement: Void kill records feature (synchronously cancels associated Discord Webhook alerts)
Enhancement: Upgraded API rate limiting to identity-based (JWT/Cookie) mode to solve false blocks for users sharing Wi-Fi
Enhancement: Comprehensively hardened API and WebSocket security input validation, removing unprotected endpoints
Fix: Prevent multiple rapid submissions when holding Enter on the kill record delete button
Fix: Improved global error prompt feedback user experience

v2_3_0.title: v2.3.0
items: New: Integrated Microsoft Clarity analytics for UX improvement insights
New: Privacy Policy updated with analytics disclosure section
Enhancement: Refactored Google Sign-In button into a reusable component with consistent styling
Enhancement: Migrated Google authentication to a backend OAuth authorization code flow for better security
Fix: Dark mode support for Credits, Legal Disclaimer, and Privacy Policy static pages

v2_2_0.title: v2.2.0
items: New: Full dark / light theme mode support across the entire site
New: Complete bilingual internationalization (zh / en)
New: Boss info panel shows details for the selected channel
Enhancement: Restructured footer navigation — Legal and Privacy pages are now standalone routes
Enhancement: Improved room management UX and minor UI polish
Enhancement: Database migrated from boss_name to boss_type_id for stable multi-language support
Fix: Boss type names now display correctly when the language is switched

v2_1_0.title: v2.1.0
items: New: Unified WebSocket architecture for real-time updates and global notifications
New: Global maintenance mode with live status broadcast
New: API rate limiting and robust session management
Enhancement: Switched to cookie-based authentication with unified WebSocket auth
Enhancement: WebSocket connection limits per user to prevent abuse
Enhancement: Docker and CI/CD pipeline improvements
Enhancement: Migrated backend dependency management to uv

v2_0_0.title: v2.0.0
items: New: Google SSO login with JWT authentication and cross-tab sync
New: Anonymous user support — guests can now record boss data without logging in
New: User preferences management (saved per account)
New: Room and record soft-delete to protect history integrity
New: WebSocket connection count limit per room
Enhancement: Boss status recording changed from dropdown to one-click buttons
Enhancement: Room ID generation moved to backend for security
Enhancement: Added Google Tag Manager and analytics tracking

v1_0_0.title: v1.0.0 (First Release)
items: Boss Timer officially launched
Support for cross-device real-time WebSocket synchronization
Credits page and attributions section added

guide.title: User Guide
guide.subtitle: Get started with Boss Timer

start.title: Create or Join a Room
steps: On the home page, enter any room name and click "Create New Room", or enter a room code shared by a friend and click "Join".
Share the room code with your teammates — all actions within the same room sync in real time.
You can sign in with Google (to save preferences) or join as a guest by entering a nickname.

record.title: Report Boss Status
steps: In the "Control Panel", select a Boss from the dropdown (supports search) and enter the channel number.
Click a status button to submit: green "Killed", red "Alive", or grey "Not Found" — the system calculates respawn times automatically.
The control panel adapts to its container width: status buttons show icons only when narrow, icons + text when wide.
Click the star icon next to a Boss to favorite it. Favorited bosses appear at the top of the dropdown.
When switching rooms, the last selected Boss is remembered automatically; rooms with custom Bosses will prefer the custom one.

view.title: View Respawn Info
steps: "Channel Overview" offers two views: Card mode (quick countdown per channel) and Gantt Timeline (visual respawn windows).
The timeline supports status filters (may respawn / respawning / alive / expired) and scrollable rows.
"Recommended Channels" automatically highlights channels worth visiting (may respawn) and those to avoid (respawning).

history.title: History & Undo
steps: "Record History" shows reports from the last 1 day by default — scroll down to infinitely load older records.
Use the date picker to choose a custom range (up to 30 days), or use the shortcut buttons: "Last 1 Day", "Last 7 Days", "Last 30 Days".
You can also filter by a specific Boss using the dropdown.
If you submitted a wrong report, click the trash icon to undo it — this also cancels any scheduled Discord alerts.

layout.title: Customize Layout
steps: Click "Customize Layout" in the top-right to enter edit mode. Drag widgets (desktop) or use the arrow buttons (mobile) to reorder.
On desktop, use the "−" and "+" buttons to adjust widget width (¼, ½, ¾, or full). Some widgets have a minimum width of ½.
In normal view, each widget has a collapse button in its top-right corner (visible on hover). Click to fold it into a thin bar.
Layout is saved automatically — locally for guests, synced to your account if signed in with Google.

settings.title: Notifications, Sound & Discord
steps: Click the gear icon in the top-right to open Settings. Toggle browser notifications and sound alerts, adjust volume and reminder timing.
In the "Discord Webhook" tab, paste a channel Webhook URL to receive kill notifications and respawn alerts (~5 min before).
In the "Custom Bosses" tab, add room-specific non-standard bosses with custom names and respawn time ranges.

guide.tipContent: The room code can be copied directly from the URL bar. Inside a room, clicking the room code in the top-left corner copies it to your clipboard.
